summary.description: One-paragraph summary of the requirements review.

findings.description: Quality findings for the reviewed requirement entity.

findingType.description: Stable finding category, e.g. AMBIGUOUS, INCOMPLETE, UNTESTABLE, INCONSISTENT.

severity.description: Relative severity, or null if unspecified.

evidenceReferences.description: Locators into the supplied context (entity refs, snippets).

suggestedIssueText.description: Proposed issue text to raise, or null for none.

suggestedNoteText.description: Proposed note text, or null for none.

suggestedPositions.description: Proposed resolve-position texts for the issue.
